messages.author: Sayan Poddar
messages.body:
Dear AMBER developers and Users,
I want to install amber20 and ambertools23. I was following the
instructions given in the amber manual.
https://ambermd.org/doc12/Amber21.pdf
I have extracted Amber20.tar.bz2 by using  *tar xvfj Amber20.tar.bz2 *and
it has extracted everything by creating a separate folder named
*amber20_src*.
However when I extracted *AmberTools23.tar.bz2 *it extracted everything in
another separate folder named *amber22_src*.
But the manual says *Note: extracts in an amber20_src” directory.*
So, can I just move the contents of *amber22_src in **amber20_src. *Will
that work?
Thank you
-- 
*with regards*
*Sayan Poddar*
*PhD Research Scholar*
*Department of Biosciences and Biomedical Engineering*
*Indian Institute of Technology Indore*
*India*

messages.author: David Case
messages.body:
AmberTools23 is not compatible with Amber20.  Amber20 should only be used
with AmberTools21.  Amber22 should be used with AmberTools23.  I know it
sounds complicated, but the cover page of each Reference Manual lists the
combinations that were used for that year: e.g. the Amber 2023 Reference
Manual says "Covers Amber22 and AmberTools23".
Best recommendation: upgrade to Amber22, and use that with AmberTools23: we
are always fixing problems as well as adding new features, and most
bugfixes don't get backported to earlier versions.
...hope this helps...dac
